name: a value inside the constraint rates
source:
tariff "t"
input rate: Money/mi = $2.35/mi where $0.50/mi..=$15/mi
charge "Linehaul" = rate * 10 mi

name: a value outside the constraint stops the rating at the input, naming the bounds
source:
tariff "t"
input rate: Money/mi = $2.35/mi where $0.50/mi..=$15/mi
charge "Linehaul" = rate * 10 mi

message.message: {0} must be from {1} to {2}; {3} is outside it

name: a list input's item outside the constraint is named by its index
source:
tariff "t"
input stops: List<Int> = [] where 0..=10
input cap: Money? = none where $0..$1_000
input heavy: Weight = 1 lb where 0 lb..200 lb
charge "x" = $1 * stops.len + (cap ?? $1) + $1/lb * heavy

name: a list constraint at rating time
source:
tariff "t"
enum Service { Standard, Guaranteed, Expedited }
input service: Service = Standard where [Standard, Guaranteed]
charge "x" = $1
note "{service}"
